source.title: One Commendation Signet
source.objective:
ProgressFor those adventurers who have but a single commendation signet, I'll exchange it for a little bit of recognition with the Steamweedle Cartel.

Please bear in mind that it is better to hand over a stack of ten signets at once; your efforts will receive greater recognition in doing so.  We offer a single signet exchange as a service for those who don't have enough for a full stack of ten.

With that being said, I stand ready to swin... er, help you if you still wish to hand in a single signet.
source.completion:
Very well - your deeds have been entered into the ledgers, and you are duly recognized for your efforts.  Keep up the good work, <class>.

If you have any more signets to hand in, I can trade with you further.
